CASE PUD 2026-000031 ENTRY NO. 138 FILED IN OCC COURT CLERK'S OFFICE ON 08/31/2026 - PAGE 1 OF 3




               BEFORE THE CORPORATION COMMISSION OF THE STATE OF OKLAHOMA
          IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF                        )
          OKLAHOMA GAS AND ELECTRIC COMPANY                          ) Case No. PUD2026-000031
          FOR COMMISSION APPROVAL OF ELECTRIC                        )
          SERVICE AGREEMENTS AND PREAPPROVAL                         )
          OF CAPACITY PURCHASE AGREEMENTS                            )
          PURSUANT 17 O.S. § 286(C)                                  )

                      OKLAHOMA SUSTAINABILITY NETWORK’S EXHIBIT LIST
                COMES NOW Oklahoma Sustainability Network (“OSN”) pursuant to Order No. 758317

         and hereby provides its exhibit list. OSN hereby identifies the following as potential exhibits for

         use at the hearing on the merits:

                1. All prefiled testimony, statements of position, exhibits and schedules filed in this Case

                    to which OSN does not object;

                2. All data requests and responses provided by any party in this Case during the course of

                    discovery to which OSN does not object;

                3. Pleadings and other documents filed of public record with the Corporation Commission

                    Clerk to which OSN does not object;

                4. OG&E’s proposed XLPL tariff;

                5. Grand River Dam Authority, Schedule LGS-SS – Supplemental Supply Rider;

                6. Evergy Kansas, Schedule CCR – Customer Capacity Rider;

                7. Georgia Power Clean and Renewable Energy Subscription, Customer Identified

                    Resource;

                8. All exhibits listed on other parties’ filed Exhibit Lists to which OSN does not object.

                OSN reserves the right to supplement and/or amend its Exhibit List.
